title: Supreme Court stays Delhi HC order for premature release of 1993 Bowbazar blast convict
description: The Supreme Court on Monday stayed Delhi High Court's recent order for the premature release of Md Rashid Khan, one of the convicts in the 1993 Bowbazar blast case from West Bengal. A Bench of Justice PK Mishra and Justice Sanjeev Sachdeva passed the interim order on a petition moved by the West Bengal government challenging the Delhi High Court ruling. It also issued a notice to Khan for his response. "Notice. In the meanwhile the impugned order to be stayed," the Court said.Justices PK Mishra
